title: Practice 1: Verbs from nouns and adjectives

blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.why: **чу́вствовать** — to feel (something). Source: Wiktionary, «-овать» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-овать#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.

exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **образова́ть** — to form, to make, to make up, to produce. Source: Wiktionary, «-овать» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-овать#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.
**образуют** — образова́ть (imperfective and perfective): to form, to make, to make up, to produce. Wiktionary: о́браз + -ова́ть.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **ве́ровать** — (literary) to believe (in, especially to believe in God). Source: Wiktionary, «-овать» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-овать#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.
**Веруем** — ве́ровать (imperfective): (literary) to believe (in, especially to believe in God). Wiktionary: вера + -овать.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **существова́ть** — to exist, to be, to live. Source: Wiktionary, «-овать» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-овать#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.
**Существую** — существова́ть (imperfective): to exist, to be, to live. Wiktionary: существо́ + -ова́ть.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to form, to make, to make up, to produce
(literary) to believe (in, especially to believe in God)
to exist, to be, to live
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: чу́вствовать — to feel (something); образова́ть — to form, to make, to make up, to produce; ве́ровать — (literary) to believe (in, especially to believe in God); существова́ть — to exist, to be, to live.
**прису́тствовать** — to be present. Source: Wiktionary, «-овать» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-овать#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.
**присутствовали** — прису́тствовать (imperfective): to be present. Wiktionary: прису́тствие + -овать.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **бесе́довать** — to converse, to talk. Source: Wiktionary, «-овать» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-овать#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.
